So thanks to the Letters Page we've been collecting a lot of characters and concepts that don't currently have art, and well, see the title of this thread. :) I thought it would be a fun thing to ask.

Some of my own wishlist:

  • Ivan's dad Fyodor Ramonat.
  • Medico's hubby Caleb Greene.
  • What Nigel Lowsley looked like before he became Infinitor.
  • The Crimson Conductor.
  • Fashion/Stylin' Shirley.
  • The Shrieker.
